alerts.arrest: 🚨 ARREST! The police raided you this morning.
alerts.wife_left: 💔 WIFE LEFT! You failed to meet her financial expectations.
alerts.heart_attack: ❤️‍🩹 HEART ATTACK! Your heart couldn’t handle the strain.
alerts.elections_lost: 🗳️ ELECTIONS LOST! With 1.2% of the votes, you lost your seat to the opposition.

bench_tender.title: Park Benches Tender
bench_tender.desc: A contractor offers a kickback to win a tender for 'luxury' park benches. Meanwhile, your wife is hinting about a new penthouse.
choices: 🧳 Take it all! Give the job to your cousin
👜 Take a moderate cut through a shell company
❌ Refuse and hold a fair and honest tender

tama_38.title: TAMA 38 Shenanigans
tama_38.desc: A developer asks you to turn a blind eye to three 'extra' floors in a downtown TAMA 38 project. He promises a solid deposit to a Swiss bank.
choices: 🏗️ Sign the permit blindly
🌳 Force him to build a park in exchange for the floors
🛑 Block the construction (developer is furious)

shelters_budget.title: Bomb Shelters Budget
shelters_budget.desc: The state allocated a huge budget to renovate old bomb shelters. Your brother-in-law suddenly opened an armored doors company.
choices: 🚪 Give the entire tender to your brother-in-law
🛠️ Give him a partial cut, do the rest honestly
🛡️ Conduct a strict independent audit

state_comptroller.title: State Comptroller Audit
state_comptroller.desc: A surprise audit from the State Comptroller hits the municipality. The auditors demand access to last year's accounting books.
choices: 💰 Bribe the chief auditor
🔥 Arrange an 'accidental' fire in the archives
🐐 Throw a low-level clerk under the bus

shabbat_blackmail.title: Coalition Crisis (Shabbat)
shabbat_blackmail.desc: Religious parties threaten to dismantle the coalition unless you close all parks and businesses on Shabbat. Your wife loves Saturday strolls.
choices: 🕍 Give in and close everything (wife is furious)
🤝 Compromise: close downtown, open in the suburbs
🖕 Tell them to get lost: we are a secular city!

lawyer_visit.title: Visit from a Fixer Lawyer
lawyer_visit.desc: A well-known fixer lawyer offers to 'lose' a couple of unpleasant files on you in Lahav 433 for a hefty fee.
choices: 💼 Pay 500,000 ₪ and sleep peacefully
🤝 Ask for a discount (pay 200,000 ₪)
❌ Kick him out: 'I am an honest mayor!'

garbage_extortion.title: Garbage Extortion
garbage_extortion.desc: Tough guys from Qalansawe showed up at the waste management tender, hinting that without their 'protection', garbage trucks might get flat tires.
choices: 👮 Go to the police (official report)
🤝 Agree and hand over the cleanup contract
🗣️ Pretend you don't speak Arabic
⚔️ Play them: invite rivals from Tayibe instead

neighbor_mayor_amuta.title: Brotherly Help to a Colleague
neighbor_mayor_amuta.desc: The mayor of Hadera panics: ahead of the elections, he urgently needs an 'amuta' (nonprofit) for donations and asks for campaign backing.
choices: 💰 Go all in through a dummy foundation
🪙 Give a small token amount just to keep up appearances
🛑 Politely refuse (no budget available)
📰 Leak kompromat on him to a local Telegram channel

shitty_burger.title: The White Burger Scandal
shitty_burger.desc: Inspectors found highly questionable meat at *White Burger*, owned by your main campaign donor. They are demanding an immediate shutdown.
choices: 🥩 Issue a retroactive license on the house
📸 PR stunt: devour a burger in front of the cameras
❌ Shut the joint down and ditch the donor

shabbat_parking.title: Shabbat Parking Hell
shabbat_parking.desc: Secular neighborhood residents are furious: streets are blocked so badly an ambulance can't pass. The opposition demands a towing crackdown.
choices: 🚜 Dispatch inspectors and tow trucks early morning
🙈 Do nothing — don't ruin people's Shabbat
🅿️ Paint blue-and-white curbs right under the Rabbi's windows

flooded_street.title: Weizmann Street Flood
flooded_street.desc: The first serious rain hit, and central Weizmann Street is completely underwater. The drainage maintenance budget vanished, and local news is roasting you.
choices: 🌞 Blame freak weather and global climate change
💸 Urgently hire your brother-in-law's firm without a tender at inflated rates
🥾 Put on rain boots for the cameras and dig the drain yourself

burning_trucks.title: Burning Garbage Trucks
burning_trucks.desc: A few days of calm are over: three garbage trucks burned overnight at the municipal depot. The words "Greetings from Qalansuwa" are spray-painted on the asphalt. Half the city is drowning in waste.
choices: 🚛 Urgently allocate 800,000 ₪ from the budget to buy new vehicles
🙈 Throw up your hands: there's no money, let it stink (the public is shocked)

kompromat_retaliation.title: Media Counterattack
kompromat_retaliation.desc: The mayor of Hadera hasn't forgiven you for the leak. A major Telegram channel has published an investigation about your "undeclared" villa in Caesarea and photos of your wife at a Milan boutique.
choices: 💼 Spend 300,000 ₪ on "friendly bloggers" to clean up the media landscape
🤐 Keep quiet (your approval rating crashes, and Lahav 433 takes an interest)

arnona_scandal.title: Arnona Tax Scandal
arnona_scandal.desc: Reporters found that your campaign donor gets an 80% property tax (Arnona) discount.
choices: 🤫 Hush it up through city lawyers (+1.5M ₪)
📉 Reduce discount to 30% for show (+300,000 ₪)
⚖️ Cancel discount and demand full payment (0 ₪)

beach_kiosk.title: Public Beach Land Grab
beach_kiosk.desc: A beach restaurant owner illegally seized 200m of public coastline for paid sunbeds.
choices: 🍹 Take a bribe and a permanent VIP table (+800,000 ₪)
🚜 Send city bulldozers to demolish illegal structures (-200,000 ₪)

electric_scooters.title: Electric Scooter Chaos
electric_scooters.desc: Residents are furious about e-scooters cluttering sidewalks and knocking over pedestrians.
choices: 🛴 Charge operators heavy annual licensing fees (+600,000 ₪)
🚫 Ban rental e-scooters in the city center completely (0 ₪)
🅿️ Paint designated parking zones (-100,000 ₪)

stadium_naming.title: Stadium Naming Rights
stadium_naming.desc: An oligarch wants to rename the municipal stadium after his holding company.
choices: 💰 Sign a 10-year deal and pocket the fee (+2M ₪)
🏛️ Keep the historic municipal name (0 ₪)

sewage_overflow.title: Main Sewage Pipe Burst
sewage_overflow.desc: The main sewer line burst, flooding the seafront promenade with wastewater.
choices: 🛠️ Allocate emergency budget for full repair (-500,000 ₪)
🙈 Claim it's just 'routine maintenance' (0 ₪)

friday_country_club.title: Friday Country Club Morning
friday_country_club.desc: Every Friday at 8:00 AM you sit by the Country Club pool. A queue of locals forms with 'small personal requests'.
choices: ☕ Settle local businessmen's issues for 'campaign donations' (+400,000 ₪)
🤝 Help regular citizens with tax/school issues using city funds (-50,000 ₪)
🚫 Put up a 'Mayor is Off-Duty' sign and head to the sauna (0 ₪)

country_cctv_raid.title: Country Club CCTV Raid
country_cctv_raid.desc: Lahav 433 investigators arrive at the Country Club and demand the surveillance servers from last Friday.
choices: 💾 Burn the server rack and blame a 'short circuit' (-300,000 ₪)
😬 Hand over the flash drive and hope for the best (+25% Threat)
